title: Fallout 4
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. Jeepers4015 (highball-db#1418, 2026-11-23), Apple M5, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK, rated 4 of 5 after 57 minutes: with the steam, vcrun2022 and controller-sdl recipes, on high settings on a 24 GB MacBook Pro. Stutters every now and then, and the game takes a while to load, otherwise fine. matheuscastrotoledo (highball-db#1425, 2026-11-24), Apple M5, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.29, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r30, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 6 minutes: with the steam recipe and the Metal HUD on.
notes: Works, script extender untested. Two reports on M5 Macs: perfect over 6 minutes with DXMT on the default engine r30, and playable with stutters now and then over 57 minutes with DXVK on r28 (highball-db#1418, #1425).

knownIssues.symptom: Stutters every now and then, and a slow load (M5, DXVK, Wine 10 r28, highball-db#1418)
